review.identity: All27 sprites visually inspected against the selected canonical neutral. Species face, eye form, muzzle, palette, markings and tail retained; no props, clothing or text.
review.style: Soft watercolor fill/paper texture inside body and warm brown contours follow this animal own canonical art. Head/body scale held within each sheet; separate fixed standing-reference scale per source sheet.
review.alpha: Genuine RGBA retained unchanged. Correct white composite inspected; all27 alpha>=8 envelopes have at least2px empty margins in all four directions. Sparse low alpha RGB/edge noise preserved rather than cleaned. Rejected gray-haze red-panda action candidate remains separate.
review.motion: Declared27 pose keys inspected. Wave low/in/out/rest and stretch half/full visibly different; clap-open differs from touching paws; crouch/air/land distinct. Airborne support explicitly inferred. These are registered key-pose stocks, not dense continuous frames or a final episode choreography acceptance.
